steps.title: The Math of the Rubik's Cube

lessons/mathematics/foundations/math-fou.goal: Represent one idea, solve it, and explain why the model works.
lessons/mathematics/foundations/math-fou.start: Choose a starting point and try one station.
lessons/mathematics/foundations/math-fou.prerequisite: Choose a level that feels useful; move down whenever a model would help.
lessons/mathematics/foundations/math-fou.check: Show the same idea with a picture, words, and an equation.

lessons/mathematics/foundations/numbers..goal: Connect number systems to the need to count, record, and calculate.
lessons/mathematics/foundations/numbers..start: Compare two ways to represent the same quantity.
lessons/mathematics/foundations/numbers..check: What can one number system express more easily than another?

lessons/mathematics/foundations/clocks-a.goal: Read and reason about time using a clock model.
lessons/mathematics/foundations/clocks-a.start: Move the clock hands and predict the time.
lessons/mathematics/foundations/clocks-a.prerequisite: Counting by fives and reading a number line.
lessons/mathematics/foundations/clocks-a.check: Explain how you found an elapsed time.

lessons/mathematics/foundations/measurin.goal: Choose a sensible unit and explain the scale of a measurement.
lessons/mathematics/foundations/measurin.start: Explore the scale and compare two objects.
lessons/mathematics/foundations/measurin.check: What unit would you choose, and why?

lessons/mathematics/algebra/unit-factory.goal: Explain how changing units changes a number without changing a quantity.
lessons/mathematics/algebra/unit-factory.start: Use the factory, then check one conversion.
lessons/mathematics/algebra/unit-factory.prerequisite: Multiplication and place value help with conversions.
lessons/mathematics/algebra/unit-factory.check: Which quantity stayed the same when the number changed?

lessons/mathematics/foundations/multipli.goal: Use equal groups and arrays to justify a product.
lessons/mathematics/foundations/multipli.start: Build an array before using a shortcut.
lessons/mathematics/foundations/multipli.check: Show why two different strategies give the same product.

lessons/mathematics/foundations/division.goal: Interpret a quotient as sharing or grouping and check it.
lessons/mathematics/foundations/division.start: Build equal groups and predict the remainder.
lessons/mathematics/foundations/division.check: How does multiplication check your quotient?

lessons/mathematics/foundations/pemdas.h.goal: Evaluate an expression by grouping and left-to-right operations.
lessons/mathematics/foundations/pemdas.h.start: Predict an answer before stepping through the expression.
lessons/mathematics/foundations/pemdas.h.check: Why do two tempting calculation orders differ?

lessons/mathematics/foundations/proporti.goal: Use a unit rate or scale factor to compare two quantities.
lessons/mathematics/foundations/proporti.start: Change a ratio and predict the matching quantity.
lessons/mathematics/foundations/proporti.check: What stayed proportional as the values changed?

lessons/mathematics/foundations/area-per.goal: Distinguish area from perimeter with a built shape.
lessons/mathematics/foundations/area-per.start: Build a shape and compare its two measurements.
lessons/mathematics/foundations/area-per.check: Can two shapes share a perimeter but have different areas?

lessons/mathematics/geometry-and-trigono.goal: Explain the square-area relationship in a right triangle.
lessons/mathematics/geometry-and-trigono.start: Change a triangle and compare the three squares.
lessons/mathematics/geometry-and-trigono.check: Why does this relation require a right triangle?

lessons/mathematics/geometry-and-trigono.goal: Estimate pi from circle measurements and explain the ratio.
lessons/mathematics/geometry-and-trigono.start: Change a circle and compare circumference with diameter.
lessons/mathematics/geometry-and-trigono.check: Which measurement changes when the circle grows, and which ratio stays?

lessons/mathematics/geometry-and-trigono.goal: Choose a trigonometric ratio to find a missing side or angle.
lessons/mathematics/geometry-and-trigono.start: Label the sides relative to one angle.
lessons/mathematics/geometry-and-trigono.check: Why does switching the chosen angle change opposite and adjacent?

lessons/mathematics/geometry-and-trigono.goal: Connect circular motion to sine and cosine graphs.
lessons/mathematics/geometry-and-trigono.start: Move the point and track its height on the wave.
lessons/mathematics/geometry-and-trigono.check: How does one full turn appear on the graph?

lessons/mathematics/algebra/linear-equat.goal: Connect constant change to slope and a line equation.
lessons/mathematics/algebra/linear-equat.start: Predict a line from its slope, then test it.
lessons/mathematics/algebra/linear-equat.check: What does the slope measure in this context?

lessons/mathematics/algebra/where-lines-.goal: Interpret the intersection of two lines as a shared solution.
lessons/mathematics/algebra/where-lines-.start: Move two lines and predict their meeting point.
lessons/mathematics/algebra/where-lines-.check: How can you check the intersection in both equations?

lessons/mathematics/advanced-and-calculu.goal: Use a graph to test a mathematical claim, then check algebraically.
lessons/mathematics/advanced-and-calculu.start: Plot a function and change one parameter.
lessons/mathematics/advanced-and-calculu.check: Which change to the equation caused the change you saw?

lessons/mathematics/advanced-and-calculu.goal: Estimate instantaneous slope using nearby secant lines.
lessons/mathematics/advanced-and-calculu.start: Zoom toward a point and compare secant slopes.
lessons/mathematics/advanced-and-calculu.prerequisite: Slope of a line and limits.
lessons/mathematics/advanced-and-calculu.check: What value do the slopes approach?

lessons/mathematics/advanced-and-calculu.goal: Interpret successive time derivatives and their units.
lessons/mathematics/advanced-and-calculu.start: Change a motion and inspect the derivative ladder.
lessons/mathematics/advanced-and-calculu.check: What does each derivative measure in this motion?

lessons/mathematics/advanced-and-calculu.goal: Explore how layered functions can model terrain and flow.
lessons/mathematics/advanced-and-calculu.start: Change a wave and observe the modeled landscape.
lessons/mathematics/advanced-and-calculu.prerequisite: Functions, graphs, and rates of change.
lessons/mathematics/advanced-and-calculu.check: Which features are mathematical models rather than claims about game code?

lessons/mathematics/advanced-and-calculu.goal: Describe a cube move as a reversible transformation.
lessons/mathematics/advanced-and-calculu.start: Try a move sequence and then reverse it.
lessons/mathematics/advanced-and-calculu.check: Why does reversing the move order matter?

lessons/mathematics/statistics-and-proba.goal: Choose a center measure that fits the data.
lessons/mathematics/statistics-and-proba.start: Add an outlier and compare mean and median.
lessons/mathematics/statistics-and-proba.check: Which measure changed most, and why?

lessons/mathematics/statistics-and-proba.goal: Compare distributions with a measure of spread.
lessons/mathematics/statistics-and-proba.start: Make two sets with the same center but different spread.
lessons/mathematics/statistics-and-proba.check: What does the center hide about these data?

lessons/mathematics/statistics-and-proba.goal: Compare predicted probability with experimental frequency.
lessons/mathematics/statistics-and-proba.start: Predict, run trials, and compare results.
lessons/mathematics/statistics-and-proba.check: Why can a small sample differ from the expected probability?

lessons/mathematics/statistics-and-proba.goal: Explain how repeated chance choices produce a distribution.
lessons/mathematics/statistics-and-proba.start: Predict the busiest bin before dropping balls.
lessons/mathematics/statistics-and-proba.check: What assumptions does this board make about each bounce?

lessons/mathematics/advanced-and-calculu.goal: Generate a recursive sequence and test claims about it.
lessons/mathematics/advanced-and-calculu.start: Extend the sequence, then inspect a claimed natural pattern.
lessons/mathematics/advanced-and-calculu.check: What evidence would support a Fibonacci claim in nature?

lessons/mathematics/algebra/exponent-exp.goal: Use powers to describe repeated multiplication and growth.
lessons/mathematics/algebra/exponent-exp.check: What changes by a fixed amount, and what changes by a fixed factor?

lessons/mathematics/algebra/algebra-tile.goal: Use area to connect a quadratic product and its factors.
lessons/mathematics/algebra/algebra-tile.check: How do the side lengths match the factors?

lessons/mathematics/algebra/completing-t.goal: Turn a quadratic into a perfect square and explain each step.
lessons/mathematics/algebra/completing-t.start: Add the missing corner in the visual model.
lessons/mathematics/algebra/completing-t.check: Why must the same value be added to both sides of an equation?

lessons/mathematics/advanced-and-calculu.goal: Approximate a periodic signal by adding sine waves.
lessons/mathematics/advanced-and-calculu.start: Build a wave from a few components.
lessons/mathematics/advanced-and-calculu.check: What details improve as more components are added?

lessons/mathematics/advanced-and-calculu.goal: Investigate how repeated growth approaches e.
lessons/mathematics/advanced-and-calculu.start: Increase compounding frequency and compare values.
lessons/mathematics/advanced-and-calculu.check: What approaches a limit, and what never becomes exactly equal?

lessons/mathematics/advanced-and-calculu.goal: Explore a visual model of zeta zeros without treating it as a proof.
lessons/mathematics/advanced-and-calculu.start: Inspect the complex-plane model and its labels.
lessons/mathematics/advanced-and-calculu.prerequisite: Prime numbers and complex-plane coordinates; extension concepts are optional.
lessons/mathematics/advanced-and-calculu.check: What would checking examples fail to prove?

lessons/mathematics/algebra/equations-ic.goal: Compare how different equations model different relationships.
lessons/mathematics/algebra/equations-ic.start: Choose one equation and unpack its quantities.
lessons/mathematics/algebra/equations-ic.check: What assumptions make your chosen equation useful?
